data.name: Solitaire 220 Plus
data.detailed_description:
"Solitaire 220 Plus" is a huge collection of famous Solitaire games presented in HD quality! Solitaire variants like Freecell, Fan, Four Seasons, Klondike, Spider, Bakers Dozen, Canfield, Golf and many more are waiting for you! Every solitaire variant includes a helpful tutorial, that can be repeated of often as you like. For every card in the game relevant information can be displayed if needed. In this way a fast introduction even to unknown solitaire variants is possible. Many different card decks are balanced with suitable card backs and backgrounds.

- More than 220 variants of Solitaire
- Detailled designed decks of cards, card backs and backgrounds
- Information for every card on demand
- Statistics and high scores
- Tutorial for each solitaire variant
- Long-lasting game fun and challenging gameplay in HD quality

reviews.review:
Be aware this game with no online element requires an always-on Internet connection.  

Interface is also very clunky.  First run, the resolution defaulted to 1024x768 and showed no option for native res.  I set it the next higher one in the list, and the game froze with a black screen and did not revert to old resolution.  Had to do a hard reset, and upon restarting I was able to reset the resolution to what it should be.  Howver, it was at this point I discovered the Internet issue.

I didn't get past that.  

This is a poorly implemented version of card games you can generally get for free.  I bought this for my mother simply because she has trouble navigating a dozen different apps, and I thought it would be a good idea to have so many together in one collection.  It wasn't.
